# FLX-2303: journey step budget exhausted

**Family:** plan/replay binding (the 2000 band)

One subject's journey took more steps than the run's declared budget. The budget exists so a state machine whose transitions cycle cannot make a run's length depend on its data; exhausting it means the Journey and the JourneyTaxonomy describe a cycle the engine will not silently truncate.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-2303
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
